Class CustomShape

java.lang.Object
TurtleDesigner
CustomShape
public class CustomShape extends TurtleDesigner
The CustomShape class represents a user-defined shape created by selecting points on the canvas.

    • drawShape

      protected void drawShape(Turtle turtle)
      Draws the custom shape by going to each point in the array by moing the turtle to the first point, then putting the pen down and moving to each subsequent point in the array. If there are less than 2 points, the shape cannot be drawn and a message is printed to the console.
      Specified by:
      drawShape in class TurtleDesigner
      Parameters:
      turtle - the Turtle instance to use for drawing the shape
